newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products fall sharply as crude values dive.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products fall sharply as crude values dive.

text.p: NWE oil products fell sharply on Tuesday, taking their lead from crude.
Gasoline plunged in line with falling crude prices. A Eurograde barge was reported sold at $202 fob ARA in late trade against $206 fob ARA.
Gas oil fell sharply with futures which knocked up to $4 a tonne off outright prices. Premiums were broadly steady, but looking a touch softer, some traders said.

Low sulphur fuel oil prices also took a dive on the back of tumbling swaps prices. Offers for cargoes were heard at $94 and $95 fob but no trading was heard done. High sulphur barge prices fell $4, though cargo values were notionally stable with market interest thin. -- London newsroom +44 171 542 8060
